# The Colorado Mountain Club

> > Colorado's premier outdoor recreation and education organization offering courses, guided trips, and wilderness training across the Front Range and beyond.

The Colorado Mountain Club (CMC) connects outdoor enthusiasts through schools, classes, and adventure trips spanning hiking, climbing, backpacking, and mountaineering. With regional groups across the Front Range and partnerships with REI and the American Mountaineering Center, CMC provides comprehensive outdoor education from CPR/AED certification to advanced crevasse rescue in destinations from RMNP to Yellowstone and international locations like Nepal and Patagonia.

## Key Topics

- Colorado hiking and backpacking
- Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP)
- Mountaineering courses and climbing schools
- Wilderness training and outdoor education
- Front Range regional groups (Denver, Boulder, Pikes Peak)
- Adventure travel (Yellowstone, Nepal, Patagonia)
- Trip reports and route descriptions
- CPR/AED and avalanche rescue
- Trail running and biking
- Guided trips and outdoor recreation
- American Mountaineering Center
- REI partnership programs
- Lost Creek Wilderness
- Brainard Lake area

## Getting Started & Organization

- [Front Range Groups](https://www.cmc.org/groups-sections/front-range-groups): CMC regional groups: Denver, Boulder, Northern Colorado, Pikes Peak
- [Schedule & Manage](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/schools-courses/schedule-manage): How-to guide for scheduling and managing CMC activities and courses
- [Schools, Classes & Trips](https://www.cmc.org/blog/schools-classes-trips): CMC outdoor education programs including courses at REI and trips to Yellowstone

## Outdoor Education & Training

- [CPR/AED for Outdoor Enthusiasts](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/schools-courses/schools-classes-overviews/cpr-aed-for-outdoor-enthusiasts): ECSI Adult CPR/AED certification course at American Mountaineering Center
- [First Aid After an Avalanche](https://www.cmc.org/blog/first-aid-after-an-avalanche): Keith Stinebaugh's guide on avalanche rescue and emergency response
- [Intermediate Alpine Climb – Advanced Crevasse Rescue](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/find-trips/intermediate-alpine-climb-2013-large-classroom-climbing-wall-west): Denver TCS Advanced Crevasse Rescue seminar at CMC Basecamp

## Route Guides & Destinations

- [Yellowstone National Park](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/yellowstone): Yellowstone NP ski, snowshoe, and hiking route information
- [Pagoda Mountain - RMNP](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/pagoda-mountain-rmnp): Pagoda Mountain 13,497' route in RMNP between Longs Peak and Chiefs Head
- [Baker Mountain via Kearney Gulch](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/baker-mountain-via-kearney-gulch): Route description for Baker Mountain 12er via Kearney Gulch bushwhack
- [Bear Creek Lake Park](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/bear-creek-lake-park): 2,624-acre Lakewood park with hiking, camping, fishing, and yurts
- [Ute Valley Park](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/ute-valley-park): Colorado Springs park with hiking, biking, and rock scrambling trails
- [Clear Creek Trail](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/clear-creek-trail): Easy year-round biking/hiking trail near Golden Visitors Center
- [Santa Fe Open Space](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/conservation-santa-fe-open-space-near-palmer-lake): 60-acre Palmer Lake open space with 2 miles of family-friendly trails
- [City Park](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/routes-places/city-park): Denver City Park route info with Zoo and Museum of Nature & Science

## Trip Reports

- [Backpack – Lost Creek Wilderness](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/trip-reports/backpack-2013-adv-bkp-lost-creek-wilderness): Trip report: 54-mile advanced backpacking loop in Lost Creek Wilderness
- [Climb – Mount Lady Washington](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/trip-reports/climb-2013-rmnp-longs-peak-th-mount-lady-washington): Trip report: Mount Lady Washington winter ice climb in RMNP
- [Hiking – Ute Trail in Gunnison Gorge](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/trip-reports/hiking-2013-ute-trail-in-gunnison-gorge): Trip report: 8-mile hike descending to Gunnison River for swimming/fishing
- [Hiking – Pinewood Reservoir](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/trip-reports/hiking-2013-pinewood-reservoir-ramsay-shockey-open-space): Trip report: 5.3 mile loop hike at Pinewood Reservoir with 574' gain
- [Fly Fishing – Tomahawk State Wildlife Area](https://www.cmc.org/education-adventure/trips/trip-reports/fly-fishing-2013-tomahawk-state-wildlife-area): Trip report: Successful fly fishing outing at Tomahawk Wildlife Area
